items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: And the quartet consisted of Joe Eldridge, Kenny Watts, Bass Hill and myself.

ctx.x: For his quartet. And Mike did all of the booking and everything. And Zutty said, well, we're going.
And the quartet consisted of Joe Eldridge, Kenny Watts, Bass Hill and myself.
I think Kenny Watts was on the piano.
